name: Neos Sight's conditional draw-into-memory at 8+ controlled objects
notes: Neos Sight is NEOS (advanced element), so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real NEOS champion (Tonoris, Creation's Will) to unlock element access. Its reserve cost is a real printed 0, so no reserve-payment decision is ever queued. Seven allies are seeded onto the field alongside the champion (8 objects total) to satisfy the 'eight or more objects' clause; an unrelated optional post-draw MZMAYCHOOSE is declined with PASS.

rulesClauses: Draw a card. If you control eight or more objects, draw a card into your memory.
